qualifiedVerdicts.content: Review 001 at 60c84eb (blind kanji-accuracy-reviewer subagent; underlying model assigned by the runtime and not disclosed): correctness CLEAN; scoped coverage CLEAN; comprehensibility CLEAN; quiz safety NEEDS FIX (F1 高価 «дорогостоящий; высокой цены» lacked guards against 大切 and 大事 «важный; дорогой», since «дорогой» primarily means "expensive" and both cards already exclude 高い for that reason; F2 食物 «пища; еда» lacked a guard against 食事 «приём пищи; трапеза», since Ožegov's «еда» sense 1 is «приём пищи» and 飯 already guards 食事; F3, medium-low confidence, 駐車 «парковка; парковаться» lacked a guard against 止める, whose JMdict sense "to park (a car)" the 駐車 body teaches as 車を止める «поставить машину»). The reviewer checked the Russian-only paragraphs of 飽きる, 鬼, 高価, 髪の毛, 飯, 飼う and 空 against standard sources and found no unjustified guard. Fix commit d6deb71: 高価 guards 大切/大事, 食物 guards 食事, 駐車 guards 止める. Recheck 001 at d6deb71: F1-F3 resolved, the diff contains only those three exclusion lines and the matching manifest hashes (the manifest reproduces), no regressions in the re-screen, the four optional items accepted as declined; correctness, scoped coverage, comprehensibility and quiz safety CLEAN. 空 note: words/空.md is byte-identical to the held batch-033 draft docs/translation-drafts/033-nature-outdoor-activity/words/空.md (raw SHA-256 983424986f18...), which is bound to the same frozen EN bytes (EN raw SHA-256 0a7cad85...); the author found no defect against EN and current conventions, and the B185 reviewer, blind to the batch-033 records, read the runtime bytes in full and confirmed the Russian-only far-off-place / 旅の空 paragraphs against JMdict-derived senses. Its Russian-only guards 天気, 気, 気分, 遠く and 遠い are retained as conservative protective pairs: the reviewer found a dictionary basis for each (そら weather, state-of-mind and far-off-place senses) but judged their necessity in an ordinary quiz not established (the article teaches only the far-off-place sense), consistent with the batch-033 qualification. C2 for these pairs therefore stays qualified rather than CLEAN: the dictionary basis is recorded separately from quiz necessity, which remains UNVERIFIED, and the symmetric guard is wider than the supported 空-遠く/遠い cells.

qualifiedVerdicts.quizTitles: Title/stem screen hand-checked; author guards beyond EN added きょろきょろ-見る (following じろじろ/ちらちら), かぎり-制限/以内/内/できるだけ, かあかあ-鳴く (following the animal-call cards that guard 鳴く), 髪の毛-髪/毛 (shared «волосы (на голове)»), 高速-速い, 骨折-折る (する-noun action «сломать»), 騒ぎ-混乱/ばたばた, 駐車-駐車場 (Russian «парковка» also names the lot), 飼う-持つ («держать»), 飯-ご飯/米/食べ物/食物, 食糧-食料品/食べ物/食物, 食物-食料品 and 食欲-もりもり; 空 keeps the five conservative guards of its held draft (天気, 気, 気分, 遠く, 遠い; see the 空 note). The review added 高価-大切/大事, 食物-食事 and 駐車-止める. The reviewer classified かぎり-以内/内, 飯-米 and the 空 guards as conservative (dictionary basis present, quiz necessity not established) and the rest as needed. All pairs are one-sided direct pairs; no existing card was changed for guards. Every EN exclusion is retained; no batch word has EN quiz_distractors. Screen-driven title choices during authoring: 鬼 «демон; водящий (в игре)» avoids the bare transliteration «они», the exact title of 彼ら; 髪の毛 «волосок; волосы (на голове)» is distinct from 髪 «волосы на голове»; 高価 «дорогостоящий; высокой цены» (not «дорогой», which overlapped 大事/大切 by segment); 食糧 «продовольствие; провиант», 食料 «продукты; съестные припасы» and 食物 «пища; еда» are mutually distinct, and every overlapping food pair is excluded in at least one direction.
